items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: Cozy Cole, had some good guys in the group. Ben Webster was in his group.

ctx.x: They used to play hotels and things, you know. Cozy Cole, had some good guys in the group. Ben Webster was in his group. Clyde Hart. These were all fine musicians, you know. But Stuff had his funny ways, you know. He was a good guy, but he was just a little crazy in the head a little bit.
Like how? What was he like? I've met him, but I never really knew him.
